gl:definition.gl:content: information and services representing an entity from a given viewpoint

gl:examples.gl:content: Examples of information are properties (e.g. maximum temperature), actual parameters (e.g. actual velocity), events (e.g. notification of status change), schematics (electrical), and visualization information (2D and 3D drawings).
Examples of services are asset services (for example providing the history of the configuration data or providing the actual velocity) and asset related services (for example providing a simulation).
Examples of viewpoints are mechanical, electrical, or commercial characteristics.

gl:ref.gl:source: IDTA-01001-3.2:2026 (Specification of the Asset Administration Shell — Part 1: Metamodel)
